fixes.explanation: That's what he says. He says of laughter, “It is folly,” and of pleasure, “What does it accomplish?” (Ecclesiastes 2:2). Now, I take laughter seriously around here, friend, so I'm just reading you the verse and keeping my mustache folded.
That's right, baker. He says he sought to cheer his body with wine and to embrace folly, “…my mind still guiding me with wisdom…” So his head stayed in the driver's seat while he did it.
